participation.context: Spoke the refusal to no one at the door, and held the boy in the same breath.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said you would not cut her and you would not write her a line lower.

title: Told the boy to hold at the lodging door

participation.context: Read the call and left it standing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the word that had failed in the yard, and you did not take it off the page.

title: Read the Nurse's call on the sheet
